Potato Salad

Built by hand, then filled by hand.

Founder Jason took the keys in August 2026 to a run down unit on New Street and renovated it himself, sharing the build as it went. The doors opened on Thursday 19 November 2026, behind a bright yellow shopfront.

The same hands on approach runs the counter. Meats are cooked and sliced in house, the sauces are made in house, and every sandwich is made to order.

Cooked and sliced in house

The meats are cooked in the shop and sliced in the shop.

Sauces made in house

Every sauce on the board is made on site.

Made to order

Your sandwich is built when you ask for it, not before.
